about: Scene edits by object id (bundle:file:pathId; no game text). hide: GameObjects made inactive. moveTo: [RectTransform, slot]: the RectTransform takes the anchors and position the slot RectTransform had in the original file. Options menu (scene_option file 9, BuildPlayer-OptionUI): Btn_Option7 (Achievements, Google Play Games) is hidden and Btn_Option8..15 move back one place in the 3-column grid. See docs/research/29-debloat.md. Inbox rows (ui_mypage GiftBoxMessageGroup, Build 44): the panel animation UI_GiftBox_Panel_On always shows ReceivePeriod, also for presents without an end date (our server sends indefinitely: 1 for every present), so its label (Txt_ReceivePeriodLabel) and day unit (Txt_ReceivePeriodValue) are hidden and only Txt_NoLimitLabel shows. See docs/LOCALIZATION.md. set: [object, dotted field, number]: a numeric field of a component takes that value. Notices web view (scene_mypage file 11, BuildPlayer-InformationUI, WebView_Info BaseWebView): backgroundColor alpha 0, so the strip of the web view that runs past the Notices box on a phone with a camera cutout (the plugin sizes it from the whole panel) is transparent and our page draws only inside the box. See docs/research/27-support-and-news.md 2.3.
